model_message.content:
Clear area mismatch: r1 eth1 Area 0.0.0.0, r2 eth1 Area 0.0.0.1, both neighbors empty. This directly explains the down adjacency.

Both interfaces are up and OSPF-enabled, so it's not admin down or passive (they'd show different states, but the Area difference is the decisive root cause). The area mismatch is confirmed by both ends' raw output.

description r1-to-r2
ip address 10.0.12.1/30
ip ospf area 0.0.0.0
ip ospf network point-to-point

model_message.content:
Confirmed via running configs: r1 eth1 `ip ospf area 0.0.0.0`, r2 eth1 `ip ospf area 0.0.0.1`. Neither eth1 has `ip ospf passive`, so passive is ruled out. Areas disagree → adjacency cannot form → no Loopback routes.

  "status": "ospf_area_mismatch",
  "conclusion": "互联链路 OSPF 区域不一致导致无法建立邻居，进而双向 Loopback 不可达。r1 eth1 处于 Area 0.0.0.0，r2 eth1 处于 Area 0.0.0.1，两端 Neighbor Count 均为 0、邻居表为空，互联接口虽 UP 但 adjacency 未建立。两端 eth1 均无 ip ospf passive，接口管理状态均为 up，故排除 admin down 与 passive。",
  "evidence_ids": ["E001", "E002", "E003", "E004", "E005", "E006", "E007"],

}
